name: Stone grave cross
description: A grey limestone Latin cross with flared ends and a ring round the crossing, set in a socket block on two dressed steps, settled a little out of true; a worn inscription panel on the socket and moss on the arms and the steps.

provenance.prompt: gravestone_cross: a stone cross on a stepped base, about 0.7 × 0.4 × 1.4 m (plan 3, item 7).
